proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Suspense and SSR hydration
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: In a real Next.js app, compare server and client query keys exactly. Inspect dehydrated state and verify only safe anonymous data appears; test hydration with a mounted QueryClientProvider.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: Never dehydrate authentication tokens, internal service responses, another user's tasks or secrets into a public HTML payload. This server-only example is not a Vite browser route.

sourceContract.title: Suspense and SSR hydration
sourceContract.expectedPositive: In a real Next.js app, compare server and client query keys exactly. Inspect dehydrated state and verify only safe anonymous data appears; test hydration with a mounted QueryClientProvider.
sourceContract.expectedNegative: The starter creates QueryClient but fails to prefetch and hydrate into the client component with a matching key.
sourceContract.securityBoundary: Never dehydrate authentication tokens, internal service responses, another user's tasks or secrets into a public HTML payload. This server-only example is not a Vite browser route.
